title: Pure Beetrooper
summary: Beetrooper cards only, with generic Insect Extra Deck monsters and staples. Beetroopers lock you into Insects and swarm the field. Scout Buggy summons a second copy from the hand, Deck or GY. Scale Bomber summons itself after any Insect summon and destroys a monster that activates. Sting Lancer summons itself on either Main Phase and searches a Beetrooper Spell/Trap. Giant Beetrooper Invincible Atlas can't be targeted or destroyed by their effects and tributes Insects to summon more Beetroopers from the Deck. Beetrooper Cruel Saturnas, the newest card, is a Fusion that searches any Beetrooper card and brings back banished Beetroopers. Beetrooper Landing fuses Insects and returns from the GY, and Beetrooper Fly & Sting negates monster effects. Every Beetrooper limits you to Insects, so the Extra Deck is all Insect.
